---
title: "Federated Study Decision Guide"
pagetitle: "Decision Guide"
---

<div class="page-header">
<p>Use this before the first technical design meeting. It separates the scientific need from the temptation to choose federated learning because it sounds modern.</p>
</div>

<div class="guide-grid">
<section class="panel">
<h2>Project Inputs</h2>

<form id="decision-form">
<div class="question">
<strong>1. Can patient-level data be centralized in a secure research environment?</strong>
<label class="option"><input type="radio" name="centralize" value="yes"> Yes, legally and practically.</label>
<label class="option"><input type="radio" name="centralize" value="no"> No, a real constraint blocks movement.</label>
<label class="option"><input type="radio" name="centralize" value="unknown"> Unknown or not yet tested.</label>
</div>

<div class="question">
<strong>2. What is the main scientific task?</strong>
<label class="option"><input type="radio" name="task" value="train"> Train a new model across sites.</label>
<label class="option"><input type="radio" name="task" value="evaluate"> Evaluate an existing model at external sites.</label>
<label class="option"><input type="radio" name="task" value="analytics"> Estimate aggregate counts, rates, or summaries.</label>
<label class="option"><input type="radio" name="task" value="local"> Support local-only models or local quality improvement.</label>
</div>

<div class="question">
<strong>3. Are variables, labels, timing, and outcomes aligned?</strong>
<label class="option"><input type="radio" name="alignment" value="aligned"> Yes, with a shared data dictionary and label protocol.</label>
<label class="option"><input type="radio" name="alignment" value="partial"> Partly; harmonization work remains.</label>
<label class="option"><input type="radio" name="alignment" value="not-aligned"> No; definitions differ across sites.</label>
</div>

<div class="question">
<strong>4. What does the collaboration already have?</strong>
<label class="option"><input type="checkbox" name="ready" value="sites"> Committed sites with named owners.</label>
<label class="option"><input type="checkbox" name="ready" value="threat"> A written privacy and security threat model.</label>
<label class="option"><input type="checkbox" name="ready" value="infra"> Compute, networking, logging, and update review.</label>
<label class="option"><input type="checkbox" name="ready" value="evaluation"> Site-level and subgroup evaluation plan.</label>
</div>

<div class="question">
<strong>5. What is the largest unresolved risk?</strong>
<select id="risk" name="risk">
<option value="governance">Governance, approvals, contracts, or ownership</option>
<option value="heterogeneity">Heterogeneity, labels, missingness, or calibration</option>
<option value="privacy">Privacy leakage, malicious updates, or operational metadata</option>
<option value="operations">Infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, or maintenance</option>
<option value="unclear">The scientific question is still unclear</option>
</select>
</div>

<div class="button-row">
<button type="button" id="make-recommendation">Recommend Design</button>
<button type="reset" class="secondary" id="reset-guide">Reset</button>
<button type="button" class="secondary" id="copy-guide">Copy Summary</button>
</div>
</form>
</section>

<section class="panel">
<h2>Recommendation</h2>
<div id="decision-result" class="result-box" aria-live="polite">
Choose the inputs and generate a recommendation.
</div>

<h2>Design Menu</h2>
<div class="resource-grid">
<div class="resource-card"><h3>Centralized Analysis</h3><p>Usually easiest to audit, debug, and validate when lawful centralization is available.</p></div>
<div class="resource-card"><h3>Federated Learning</h3><p>Best reserved for multicentre model training where raw data cannot move and shared training is scientifically necessary.</p></div>
<div class="resource-card"><h3>Federated Evaluation</h3><p>Appropriate when a finished model must be tested at sites that cannot export patient-level data.</p></div>
<div class="resource-card"><h3>Federated Analytics</h3><p>Often enough for counts, rates, feasibility checks, and distributed descriptive analyses.</p></div>
</div>
</section>
</div>

<script>
const guideForm = document.getElementById("decision-form");
const resultBox = document.getElementById("decision-result");
const button = document.getElementById("make-recommendation");
const copyButton = document.getElementById("copy-guide");

function checkedValue(name) {
  const field = guideForm.querySelector(`[name="${name}"]:checked`);
  return field ? field.value : "";
}

function checkedList(name) {
  return Array.from(guideForm.querySelectorAll(`[name="${name}"]:checked`)).map((item) => item.value);
}

function labelForReady(value) {
  return {
    sites: "site owners",
    threat: "threat model",
    infra: "infrastructure",
    evaluation: "evaluation plan"
  }[value] || value;
}

function renderRecommendation() {
  const centralize = checkedValue("centralize");
  const task = checkedValue("task");
  const alignment = checkedValue("alignment");
  const ready = checkedList("ready");
  const risk = document.getElementById("risk").value;

  if (!centralize || !task || !alignment) {
    resultBox.innerHTML = `<strong>Discovery first.</strong><p>Answer the data movement, task, and alignment questions before choosing an architecture.</p>`;
    return;
  }

  let title = "Discovery sprint before architecture";
  let why = "The project has unresolved design information that can change the method choice.";
  let next = "Run a two-week feasibility sprint: legal route, data dictionary, one test extract, and a draft evaluation table.";

  if (centralize === "yes" && task === "train") {
    title = "Start with centralized analysis";
    why = "If lawful centralization is available, it is usually simpler to debug, monitor, and validate than FL.";
    next = "Document why centralization is acceptable, then compare against a local-only baseline and a site-held-out validation plan.";
  } else if (task === "evaluate") {
    title = "Federated evaluation";
    why = "The model already exists, so the scientific need is external validation rather than distributed training.";
    next = "Prepare a containerized model, locked preprocessing, per-site metrics, and calibration and subgroup reports.";
  } else if (task === "analytics") {
    title = "Federated analytics";
    why = "Aggregate statistics do not require the cost and attack surface of distributed model training.";
    next = "Define the aggregate query, disclosure controls, minimum cell-size rules, and audit log.";
  } else if (task === "local") {
    title = "Local-only or hybrid design";
    why = "If the goal is local improvement, shared governance may not justify shared training.";
    next = "Use a common protocol and compare local models with local validation and optional federated benchmarking.";
  } else if (centralize === "no" && task === "train" && alignment === "aligned" && ready.length >= 3) {
    title = "Federated learning candidate";
    why = "The data cannot move, the task needs shared model training, definitions are aligned, and enough operational pieces exist.";
    next = "Draft the federation protocol: threat model, aggregation method, site weighting, update review, and failure handling.";
  } else if (centralize === "no" && task === "train" && alignment !== "aligned") {
    title = "Harmonize before FL";
    why = "FL will move gradients or model updates, but it will not make labels, timestamps, outcomes, or missingness comparable.";
    next = "Freeze the cohort definition, data dictionary, label protocol, preprocessing, and per-site quality checks before training.";
  } else if (centralize === "unknown") {
    title = "Do not choose FL yet";
    why = "Unknown data-movement constraints often produce unnecessary technical complexity.";
    next = "Ask legal, ethics, data-protection, and IT teams for a written answer on centralization and remote execution.";
  }

  const missing = ["sites", "threat", "infra", "evaluation"].filter((item) => !ready.includes(item));
  const riskText = {
    governance: "Resolve governance and responsibility before protocol lock.",
    heterogeneity: "Prioritize site-level data profiling and worst-site performance.",
    privacy: "Write the threat model and select defences before training.",
    operations: "Prove the operational loop with a dry run before research training.",
    unclear: "Clarify the clinical decision, target population, and intended use."
  }[risk];

  resultBox.dataset.summary = `${title}. ${why} Next: ${next} Main risk: ${riskText}`;
  resultBox.innerHTML = `
    <span class="badge">${title}</span>
    <p><strong>Why:</strong> ${why}</p>
    <p><strong>Next action:</strong> ${next}</p>
    <p><strong>Risk focus:</strong> ${riskText}</p>
    ${missing.length ? `<p><strong>Missing readiness items:</strong> ${missing.map(labelForReady).join(", ")}.</p>` : `<p><strong>Readiness:</strong> All listed readiness items are checked.</p>`}
  `;
}

button.addEventListener("click", renderRecommendation);
guideForm.addEventListener("reset", () => {
  setTimeout(() => {
    resultBox.removeAttribute("data-summary");
    resultBox.textContent = "Choose the inputs and generate a recommendation.";
  }, 0);
});
copyButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const summary = resultBox.dataset.summary || resultBox.textContent.trim();
  await navigator.clipboard.writeText(summary);
  copyButton.textContent = "Copied";
  setTimeout(() => (copyButton.textContent = "Copy Summary"), 1200);
});
</script>
